corpus.unit: a task: a close is a task whose program the ladder closes
corpus.what: the frozen 151-task set of registered ladder runs 2 and 3 (history-admit 33, history-fix 8, guard 27, rename 83)

criterion.C1: Share. Every task of the 151-task corpus has exactly one record made with `rce repair json known ORIGINAL proposals PROPOSALS MUTANT` in `observe` mode (`bound 2000`), and every task left open by rungs a to e whose mutant parses has at least one proposal judged. Let E be exact closes (rungs a to e) and F be open tasks on which rung f observes at least one admitted proposal: E + F > 0 and 100 * F <= 2 * (E + F) (at most 2% of closes from rung f).
criterion.C2: W-MUT-1. Every observed proposal passes the mutation gate W-MUT-1 (`mutation.vacuous == 0`).
criterion.C3: GOOD. Zero observed proposals contradict the task's known-good original (`observed.known.contradicts == 0` under `rce equiv` state bound 20,000).
criterion.holds: C1, C2 and C3 all hold.

evaluated_arms.arm_A_combined_external: Proposals file per task combining FormJEPA-v1 (k=16 latent-ranked candidates) and recorded H15 external model proposals (`origin` labels `form-jepa-v1` and `h15-recorded`), evaluated by `rce repair criterion json`.
evaluated_arms.arm_B_form_jepa_only: Proposals file per task containing only FormJEPA-v1 (k=16 latent-ranked candidates, `origin` label `form-jepa-v1`), evaluated by `rce repair criterion json`.

evaluated_by: rce repair criterion json REGISTRATION CORPUS RECORDS (spec 10.13, RF-6), verified against both upstream spec/proposals/repair-observe/criterion.json and this PREREG_rung_f.json

observation.command: rce repair json known ORIGINAL proposals PROPOSALS MUTANT
observation.proposals: Canonical JSON rce-proposals/1 file per task generated strictly from mutant text and rce check diagnostic without reading original
observation.records: 151 rce-repair/1 JSON lines, one per task in corpus order

predictions.P1_exact_known_closes: Rungs a to e with `known ORIGINAL` close ~116 of 151 tasks at 0 model calls, leaving ~35 tasks open (25 of which fail parse with W-SYN-1 so rung f skips them under RF-2, and ~10 of which parse and enter rung f).
predictions.P2_gate_and_contradiction_safety: 100% of rung-f observed proposals pass W-MUT-1 (C2 holds) and 0 contradict ORIGINAL (C3 holds).
predictions.P3_share_cap_keeps_observe: When external proposers close more than 2 of the parsing open tasks (F >= 3 against E = 116, stochastic share > 2.0%), C1 blocks promotion to `auto`, confirming by exact measurement why rung f remains in `observe` mode.

question: Across all 151 tasks of ladder runs 2 and 3 at openIE-dev/rce 1762fb4b, how many open tasks does `rce repair` rung f admit in `observe` mode when fed FormJEPA-v1 and recorded H15 proposals, what is the W-MUT-1 pass rate and contradiction count against ORIGINAL, and does the registered 2% stochastic-close promotion criterion hold?
